messages:
Nina: Quick idea - our snack shelf is a sad place. What if we try a biweekly snack subscription to avoid ad-hoc runs? Could rotate who picks the box. Thoughts? :package: :yum:
Eli: Love this. Can we make it peanut-free? We have a new teammate with a severe allergy. Also maybe option for vegan snacks.
Tori: 100% peanut-free is a must. Also +1 for vegan options. Maybe have an allergen list on the box sticker.
Nina: Good call. I can draft a short policy: 'Peanut-free default, label all allergens, leave portion for sharing, personal items labeled'. Will post a draft.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Reminder - if using company card for subscriptions, finance needs a purchase order. Use `/create-po KITCHEN_SNACKS` to start.
Eli: Does subscription lock us in? I prefer a flexible 2-month trial.
Tori: We could pick a provider with monthly pause. Also set budget cap like $120/month.
Jae: Also toaster oven is flaky. If we subscribe, can we include disposable single-use plates/spoons so people don't try to use the toaster for non-toast things? 
Nina: Good point about utensils. I'll add a small sign: 'Please use disposable utensils from the box for shared snacks'.
Eli: Also can we fix the label system? I've been tagging leftovers with my initials and date but others don't. Maybe a roll of masking tape + marker by the shelf?
Tori: I'll buy a roll and stick a marker in the kitchen. Also propose a "Snack Captain" rota: one person every 2 weeks to check inventory and manage subscription.
Nina: I'm happy to be Snack Captain for the next 2 weeks to pilot it. Will handle PO form and pick options (vegan + peanut-free).
ops-bot: ops-bot: Inventory snapshot before subscription: coffee_pods=5, oat_milk=1, disposable_utensils=3, plates=6. Auto-order disabled.
Jae: Heads up - found someone else's sushi in the fridge with no name and now it's suspiciously swollen. Tossed it and left a '72h fridge rule' sticky. Maybe add a clear rule about perishable takeouts.
Eli: Thanks Jae. Also request: let's keep a sealed jar of instant coffee as backup when pods run out. Pods break sometimes.
Nina: Noted. I'll include instant coffee and extra oat milk in the first subscription box.
Tori: If Snack Captain gets a receipt, please drop it in #finance and tag `REDWOOD-KITCHEN`. Finance prefers a short note: what box was purchased and subscription URL.
Nina: Will do. I'll create PO today and post options for a quick vote. 2 options max so it's not decision paralysis.
Eli: Vote: option A = Mixed healthy snacks (granola, crackers, fruit bars), option B = Savory focus (chips, pretzels, hummus packs). I'm team A.
Jae: Team A too. +1 for marked allergen list.
Nina: Cool. If no objections by EOD, I'll place a 1-month trial order and set pause after 30 days unless we extend.
Tori: Sounds perfect. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
Nina: Also left a small sticky on the shelf with 'Masking tape + marker here' so people will notice.
